stops.name: Terme di Saturnia
stops.detail: Terme di Saturnia is an international thermal park in the Maremma of Grosseto, formed by a hydrothermal spring that flows at a constant temperature of 37.5 degrees. The spring, in addition to providing the aforementioned thermal park, feeds, downstream and with a lower water temperature, also the Waterfalls of the Mill, free access. The complex is located in Follonata, near Saturnia, in the town of Manciano, in the province of Grosseto.
